A few good questions

Wondering about something?

Here are the little things worth knowing before you get started.

What can I do with PostSprint?

PostSprint is designed for creating social posts, planning a content calendar, organizing media and managing your content workflow from one dashboard. This landing page is a frontend demonstration.

Can I really publish posts from this page?

Not from this demo. You can type, switch between post previews and copy a caption. Real publishing requires a backend and approved platform integrations.

Will I need to share my social media passwords?

No. A live integration should use the social platform's official authorization and permissions rather than requesting your social account password.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes, this homepage and the interactive post preview adapt to mobile and desktop screens.
